title: [Hinglish - Instagram/YouTube only] Agent ko poora chat mat do
content:
Research, code, aur review
1 hi chat mein mat daalo.
Context usi chat mein bhar jaata hai,
aur purani files dubara padhi jaati hain.

A subagent runs in its own context window.
Uske paas apna prompt hota hai,
apne tools hote hain,
aur wo main chat ko 1 summary de kar
wapas aata hai.
Claude Code glossary yeh kehti hai.
Subagent usi session ke andar rehta hai
jisne use start kiya.

Use it to keep a wide search
out of the main chat.

Built-in naam docs mein hain.
Explore. Plan. Aur general-purpose.
Custom agent tab banao
jab wahi kaam baar baar aaye.
Make one when the same job keeps coming back.
Jaise security review, test failures,
ya docs ka proofread.
Har naye prompt mein wo role mat likho.
Stop pasting the same role into every chat.

Project agent ka folder hai .claude/agents.
Is repo ke liye hai. Commit karo,
taaki team ko wahi agent mile.
Home folder mein .claude/agents
tumhare saare projects mein aata hai,
team ke git repo mein nahi.

Commit the project file
so the team shares the same agent.
Keep the personal file at home
if it is only for you.

Agar same naam 2 jagah ho,
docs ki order yeh hai.
Managed settings pehle.
Phir is session ka CLI flag, --agents.
Phir project folder.
Phir home folder.
Phir plugin.
Project wala file home wale file ko
beat karta hai.
The project file wins over the home file.

Put the team rule in the repo,
not only on your laptop.

Current Claude Code mein
slash agents wizard nahi kholta.
Docs kehti hain yeh command
1 reminder print karti hai.
Claude se file likhwao,
ya folder khud edit karo.
Edit the markdown file directly.
Wizard wala behaviour
v2.1.197 aur usse pehle tha.

If a clip says the wizard will open,
check the version before you repeat it.

The description is the trigger.
Frontmatter mein name hota hai.
Description mein likho ye agent kab chahiye.
Claude ke article, subagents in Claude Code,
yeh point kehta hai.
"Security expert" kamzor trigger hai.
"Reviews code for security issues
before commits" better trigger hai.

Be specific about when to delegate.
A job title is a weak trigger.

Tools bhi kaat sakte ho.
Docs ka example 1 reviewer ko
Read, Grep, Glob, aur Bash deta hai.
Maan lo tum nahi chahte
ki reviewer files likhe.
Write tool us list mein mat daalo.

The tool list is the CONTROL.
A sentence that says please do not edit
is weaker than leaving the tool off.

Say the task is a wide search.
Poora repo dhundhna hai
ki ye function kahan call hota hai.
Wo search Explore pe bhejo,
ya apne search agent pe.
Main chat mein file dumps mat chipkao.
Agent summary laaye. Tum summary padho.
Phir sirf wo change karwao
jo summary support karti hai.

Send the search out.
Read the summary.
Then change only what the summary supports.

Agent ko apna model bhi de sakte ho.
Frontmatter mein model set hota hai.
Mehnga model har search pe mat lagao.
Review pe lagao, jahan galti costly ho.
Search pe halka model kaafi ho sakta hai
jab kaam sirf files dhoondna hai.

That split is allowed in the docs.
It is not a savings number
I measured on a bill.
Apna usage slash usage se dekho.
Check /usage on your own account.

Subagent ka result usi session tak hai.
Kal wali chat ko yaad nahi rehta,
jab tak tum summary khud na likh do.
Docs cross-session messaging
ko alag feature batati hain.
Cross-session memory is a different feature.

Do not assume tomorrow's chat
remembers today's agent.

Mera take simple hai.
Jo kaam repeat hota hai,
uska 1 markdown file .claude/agents mein rakho.
Description mein trigger likho.
Tools mein sirf wahi haath do
jo us kaam ke liye chahiye.
Main chat ko summary do, poora dump nahi.

1 file. 1 trigger. A short summary back.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
